title: gladiolus floribundus subsp. fasciatus
intro: Gladiolus floribundus subsp. fasciatus, commonly known as the sword lily or gladiolus, is a plant species within the family Iridaceae. It is a perennial flower that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits. The plant is known to have anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Gladiolus floribundus subsp. fasciatus include isobutylamides, isobutyric acid, and other iridoid glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
